ws_policy.title: Receipt Policy
values: Transactions strictly over this amount require receipt follow-up
Personal Card, Travel Card, and other types handled separately
Pending = already being processed; Disputed = under investigation
Monday.com board for receipt tracking items
Cardholder must submit receipt within this window
